summary: Ran the backfill-agent-journal script in the gizmo repo to import 94 past sessions into a new .agent-journal/ directory, producing 135 numbered markdown segments and an index.jsonl (106 pi-archive + 29 claude-code). Verified the output by listing files and reading a sample segment, then asked the user whether to add .agent-journal/ to .gitignore.
decisions: User chose to commit .agent-journal/ to git rather than gitignoring it, making the imported transcript history shared team knowledge visible in code review.
